newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mystery fumes in Japan school, 60 taken to hospital.
newsitem.headline: Mystery fumes in Japan school, 60 taken to hospital.

text.p: Mysterious pungent fumes spread through classes at a junior high school in downtown Tokyo on Thursday, causing 60 students to be taken to a nearby hospital, Fire Department officials said.
The officials said they did not know the source or nature of the fumes at the school in Fukagawa, eastern Tokyo.
They said the students were taken to hospital by ambulances after complaining of sore throats. Paramedics treated another 50 students at the school, which is for ages 13 to 15.
The officials said there were no chemical experiments being conducted in the school laboratory and no chemical factories nearby which could have been the source of the fumes.

Last year, there were several cases of mysterious fumes in public places, which police attributed to pranksters using cans of spray mace. The incidents followed a nerve gas attack on the Tokyo subway in March that year which killed 12 people and made another 6,000 ill.
The leader and followers of the doomsday cult Aum Shinri Kyo (Supreme Truth Sect) are on trial for the subway attack.
